newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strasbourg air cargo up 10.8pct Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Strasbourg air cargo up 10.8pct Jan-Aug.

text.p: Air cargo traffic handled at Strasbourg-Entzheim Airport in the first eight months of the year totalled 4,567 tonnes, up 10.8 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.
Air Jet, the airline subsidiary of French express distribution company, Jet Services, operates a nightly air cargo service between Strasbourg and Paris/CDG using a 5.6 tonne-capacity HS748 aircraft.
Strasbourg also features as a stopover on Air Jet's British Aerospace BAe146QC (quick change) cargo service which operates: Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille- Paris/CDG.
In July 1996, DHL Worldwide Express announced plans to create a regional air cargo hub at Strasbourg Airport.
Postal traffic handled at Strasbourg for the eight months ending August, totalled 3,396 tonnes, a decrease of three percent on 1995 levels.
French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Strasbourg on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft.
